posts.post: wearing a coat when it’s 60 degrees out: a high-fashion necessity or just someone who can't handle a breeze?
if you actually wear everything in your closet, you’re either lying or you’re a minimalist who needs more chaos.
taking your shoes off at someone’s house and realizing your socks don’t match your vibe is a specific kind of internal panic.
people who keep the tags on their clothes until they leave the house are living life on the edge.
